waho.notes: Current WAHO record is handled by the existing configured adapter.

tenderdetail.notes: Detail route is reconstructed with a fixed WAHO path; parser compatibility is hypothetical.

all_business_africa.notes: A literal status=open query can be placed in listing_url only if paginated adapter markup/routes fit; there is no filter model or filtered type.

ungm.notes: No form submission, session/CSRF, or browser adapter capability.

blocking_findings: WahoPaginatedAdapter._detail_url hardcodes /tenders/tenders/{id}/list, preventing generic configuration of differing detail routes.
Default AdapterRegistry registers only paginated_html_list and legacy wahoo, both to the WAHO adapter.
Per-source crawl policy, headers/auth, source timezone, and typed filters are not represented in SourceSpec/factory inputs.
Source discovery accepts arbitrary configured URLs and follows redirects without public-address or host restrictions.

waho_leakage_findings.finding: Timezone-less machine timestamps default to UTC based on a WAHO-specific assumption.
Naive timestamps are treated as UTC with justification tied to WAHO.
